scope: Targeted primary-source search; abstracts and method-introduction portions opened. This is not an exhaustive novelty audit or a full-paper reproduction.
direct_3d_grounding_tta: No directly matching3DvisualgroundingTTA paper was identified in this narrow search; absence is not established and no first-in-task claim is made.

papers.title: Reg-TTA3D: Better Regression Makes Better Test-time Adaptive3D Object Detection
papers.verified_content: Focuses on regression adaptation, uses noise-consistency pseudo-label generation and confidence-guided regression refinement; discusses why classification-style BN adaptation is insufficient for localization.
papers.implication: A negativeLN entropy result cannot reject geometricTTA. Regression-specific objectives/update interfaces are an existing direction; merely adapting boxregression or using noise consistency is not new.

papers.title: DPO: Dual-Perturbation Optimization for Test-time Adaptation in3D Object Detection
papers.verified_content: Uses model/inputBEV perturbations, a reliableHungarian matcher to filter perturbation-sensitive pseudo-labels, and earlyHungarian cutoff.
papers.implication: Reliability plus geometricperturbation matching has priorart. A grounding contribution must address language-conditioned instance assignment and physically valid coordinate/pose feedback, not claim the generic matching mechanism is novel.

papers.title: MOS: Model Synergy for Test-Time Adaptation on LiDAR-Based3D Object Detection
papers.verified_content: Online3Ddetector adaptation uses a bank of historicalcheckpoints andsynergyweights based on predictedboxsimilarity andfeature independence; includes combined crossdataset/corruption conditions.
papers.implication: Onlinecheckpoint memory is existing3DdetectorTTA territory. Our currentepisodicpointPCA experiment does not test this setting or support an onlineadaptation claim.

current_research_entry: Separate yawidentifiability from semanticinstancecorrectness under partialpointvisibility. FixedpointPCA demonstrates an available geometric signal but retains a severe negative tail and changes6D output to7D; it is an engineering/mechanism reference, not a novelTTA claim.
